description: Shows an interactive live chart from Vela, our next-generation charting platform, inside the chat: crypto candles streamed from Hyperliquid or Binance in the user's browser, with optional native indicators, horizontal levels, shaded zones and a date range. Use it when the user wants to see or discuss a crypto market visually. Returns a chart_id; change or read the open chart afterwards with chart_command rather than opening a new one. This result describes the chart in words and carries no prices; once the chart is on screen, chart_command (including its read op) also returns the last price, the day's change, the visible high and low and each indicator's latest value. It never returns candles. Symbols: "BTC" or "hyperliquid:BTC" (Hyperliquid perpetuals), "binance:BTCUSDT" (Binance spot); a bare pair ending in USDT/USDC goes to Binance.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

label.description: Short label shown on the line, e.g. "Resistance".

range.description: Visible date range, ending on the newest candle.

label.description: Short label shown in the zone, e.g. "Demand".
